label: A favouring determination that makes a verdict value does not back is not pure
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: for every favouring profile phi, if phi makes a verdict the betterness standard does not back (for some scenario and candidates x, y, phi favours x over y there and x is not better than y there), then the real determination that a favouring of the bearer is phi is not a pure perfection (DEF-PURE-PERFECTION). With the standard read as value it is the arbitrariness half of 'restriction of favouring content is limitation': a standing preference against value, or among value-tied candidates, is not a pure perfection. It concerns the profile, the favouring as a function of the scenario; a contingent selection among candidates the profile leaves unranked is not a verdict of the profile and is not covered.
